description: Change backup retention days in TOML with a comment, value from a runbook note. DISTILL-CANARY-26e106cd

files.ops/backup.toml:

daily = 14     # days
weekly = 8     # weeks

After the audit, keep daily backups for 21 days. Weekly and monthly are unchanged.
